name: nasa-config-ui-tests
description: Test-only dependencies for the nasa web UI (jsdom DOM tests, playwright-core e2e). No runtime bundle.

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:js: for f in internal/ui/static/js/*.js ui/e2e/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo JS_SYNTAX_OK
